question: Does a learned positive spatial preconditioner improve withheld diffraction after three measurement-conditioned internal updates, relative to the identical unlearned updates and a pointwise learned control?
scope: Training/development pilot only. Existing v1 material and stress scores have been observed; this pilot does not access them or relabel them blind.

input.initial: Unchanged original v1 normalized LSQML1000 object, probe, calibrated positions and visible indices
input.labels: Original training_ids in W/IC only for the outer loss; TP query_ids for validation only. All inner update targets are visible_ids.
input.model_state: One coherent complex field; no physical mixed-state or calibrated covariance claim.

method.step: Global one-dimensional minimum of exact intensity quartic on [0,1], endpoints included
method.derivative: Complete finite-unroll derivatives; step IFT only on certified isolated nondegenerate interior branches or zero derivative on strict endpoints. Uncertified backward aborts and records failure; no substituted gradient.
method.features: Existing nine common-phase invariant channels, using current state and gradient rescaled by sum(w)/2; weights shared across all three updates
method.precision: complex64 / float32, no TF32; actual arithmetic nonincrease checked with declared numerical tolerance
method.visible_loss_scope: Monotone inner visible objective at fixed observations; no theorem of unseen-data improvement
method.numerical_visible_tolerance: 5e-7 absolute plus 2e-5 times the expected visible half-MSE; actual next-state and final validation loss are checked against the polynomial.

models.uniform: No learned weights, identical three exact-line updates

optimization.outer_loss: Mean squared normalized raw detector intensity on original training_ids
optimization.query_sampling: 256 original permitted training IDs, without replacement unless fewer available
optimization.checkpoint_selection: Lowest equal TP1/TP2 x three budget relative intensity RMSE; ties earliest; include initialization0; retain every checkpoint and both seeds. This is validation, not fresh test performance.

controls.meaning: Uniform exact-line trajectory saved at fixed counts, including zero (unchanged input). Three steps is the matched operator-work control;10/30 are additional-cost context, never claimed matched.
controls.labels: All9 train conditions use full original training_ids; six TP conditions use query_ids. No material/stress targets.
controls.baseline: Retain existing native1000/5000 and prior v1 validation results as historical context; runtime and objective differ.

metrics.primary: Equal TP scan and budget mean relative intensity RMSE, separately per seed and kind
secondary: Uniform comparisons at matched three updates
Visible loss before/after and line branch certificates
Forward/adjoint frame counts, training time, measured allocated memory
All selected checkpoint parameters and files

decision.positive: If spatial or pointwise internal learning consistently improves matched unlearned steps on TP and meaningful training-side held measurements, inspect attribution and freeze a separate follow-up study.
decision.negative: If changes are negligible or erase initialization quality, retain all curves and diagnose direction/gradient information rather than expand blind hyperparameter grids.
decision.material_confirmation: Requires a later transparent observed-benchmark evaluation plus independent confirmation; not part of this pilot.

resources.remote_gpu0: uniform trajectories then seed2026110203 learning if snapshot and environment checks pass
resources.remaining_fit_schedule: Second seed for both architectures, no duplicated completed jobs; use freed GPU slots.
